text: Quite a lot, probably around five hours a day. I mostly use it for messaging my friends, watching short videos and checking the news, though I know it's a bit too much.

tips.en: Contractions and spoken words make speech sound natural.
tips.kk: Қысқартулар мен ауызекі сөздер сөйлеуді тірі етеді.
tips.ru: Сокращения и разговорные слова делают речь живой.

questions.followUp: What do you use it for most?
questions.question: Let's talk about your phone. How often do you use your phone every day?

text: Yes, when I'm studying or sleeping. I put it on silent mode, otherwise I keep checking notifications, and then I can't concentrate on anything for more than a few minutes.

questions.question: Do you ever turn your phone off?

text: Once, yes, on a bus last year. I felt really panicked because all my photos were on it. Luckily, a kind woman found it and called my number, so I got it back the same evening.

questions.question: Have you ever lost your phone?

text: I think it depends on their age. For primary school children, it's probably not necessary, but teenagers may need one to contact their parents, so I'd say around twelve is reasonable.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and avoids being absolute.
